name: Pixplet Media Library – Free Stock Photos for WordPress
author: Pixplet

sections.description:
Pixplet Media Library is a WordPress plugin that lets you search free stock photos and import images directly into your Media Library without leaving your website.

Visit Pixplet to browse free stock photos.

Find high quality free images by keyword, browse a dedicated photo library inside your admin, preview images, and import them with one click. Imported images can be instantly used in posts, pages, and landing pages.

The plugin also allows you to quickly set featured images from the editor sidebar, helping you speed up content creation and publishing.

Pixplet Media Library is ideal for bloggers, publishers, businesses, marketers, and anyone who needs fast access to free stock photos directly in WordPress.

Key features

  • Search free stock photos directly inside WordPress
  • Import images into the WordPress Media Library in one click
  • Browse a dedicated Pixplet photo library in admin
  • Preview images before importing
  • Set imported images as featured images from the editor
  • Browse images by category
  • Open the original image page on Pixplet

Whether you run a blog, magazine, company website, or content platform, Pixplet Media Library helps you work with images faster and more efficiently.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/pixplet-media-library directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Open Media > Pixplet Library to browse and import images.
  4. Open any supported post type with featured images enabled to use the Pixplet Featured Image sidebar panel.
sections.faq:
Do I need an account to use Pixplet Media Library?

No. Pixplet is free to use and does not require an account for image browsing or downloads.

Can I use Pixplet images for commercial projects?

Pixplet images are intended for personal and commercial projects according to the Pixplet license terms. Review the image page on Pixplet when you need full usage details.

Does the plugin connect to an external service?

Yes. The plugin retrieves image data from the private Pixplet API and downloads the selected image when you choose to import it into your WordPress Media Library.
sections.changelog:
1.1.1

  • Fixed the main Business & Finance category slug so it loads images from the correct Pixplet category.

1.1.1

  • Updated the plugin to use the private Pixplet API endpoint for image search, category browsing, and image imports.
  • Kept the private API URL on the server side only, away from the admin JavaScript layer.

1.1.0

  • Improved first load performance by removing the category API request and using the complete built-in Pixplet category list.
  • Removed the obsolete iPhone Wallpapers category.
  • Fixed the History category slug so it loads the correct Pixplet results.
  • Removed unreliable order-by controls and simplified browsing to category and keyword search.
  • Improved responsive layout for category and search controls on desktop and mobile.
  • Hid the Load more button when there are no more results.
  • Optimized admin previews to use smaller thumbnail and preview image URLs instead of original image URLs.
  • Added short-lived caching for image search responses.
  • Improved modal close button reliability.
  • Improved import validation by checking Pixplet image details and restricting imported image URLs to Pixplet domains.

1.0.0

  • First public release of Pixplet Media Library.
  • Browse, search, preview, and import Pixplet images.
  • Set imported images as featured images from the editor sidebar.
